description: The methods sodetlib calls on a SmurfControl, frozen so that a change to this client cannot remove one without the removal being a decision. Generated from a measurement of sodetlib at the commit named below; regenerate only when sodetlib's own use changes, and say why in the commit message.

deliberately_dropped._cryo_root: A register-path builder. sodetlib used it at operations/uxm_relock.py:97 to reach etaScanInProgress; set_eta_scan_in_progress(band, 0) does that now, and get_eta_scan_in_progress already read it. Needs the matching sodetlib change.
deliberately_dropped._band_root: A register-path builder with no caller in either repository; removed with _cryo_root, whose prefix chain it was part of.
deliberately_dropped._channel_root: A register-path builder with no caller in either repository.
deliberately_dropped.rtm_spi_max_root: A register path prefix. sodetlib used it at util.py:676 to address the TES bias DACs; the public operation for that is set_current_mode, which sodetlib still has to grow. Needs the matching sodetlib change.
deliberately_dropped._rtm_slow_dac_data_reg: The register leaf that went with rtm_spi_max_root, and unreachable without it.
deliberately_dropped.sysgencryo: A register path prefix, reached only through _cryo_root.
deliberately_dropped.band_root: A register path prefix, reached only through _band_root.
deliberately_dropped.cryo_root: A register path prefix, reached only through _cryo_root.
deliberately_dropped.channel_root: A register path prefix, reached only through _channel_root.
deliberately_dropped.rtm_cryo_det_root: A register path prefix, reached only through rtm_spi_max_root.
